name: Plane
short_description: Open-source Jira alternative to track issues, sprints, and product roadmaps.
description: Plane is a powerful open-source project management tool designed to track issues, run sprint cycles, and manage product roadmaps. It offers a robust rich text editor, sub-properties, referenced issues, and cycle tracking with burn-down charts. You can simplify complex projects with modules, customize views with filters, and capture ideas in Plane Pages. The complete stack includes a web UI, API, workers, Postgres database, Redis cache, RabbitMQ broker, and MinIO object storage for attachments.
usecases: Run agile sprint cycles with burn-down charts and issue tracking.
Manage product roadmaps and divide complex projects into modules.
Replace Jira with a fast, modern, fully self-hosted alternative.
Capture notes, ideas, and actionable items using Plane Pages.
notes: This is a heavy enterprise-grade stack (12 containers). Requires at least 4 GB of RAM (8 GB recommended).
The first boot will take a few minutes as the database migrations run.
Attachments are stored in a self-hosted MinIO bucket automatically configured.
